messages:
maria-ic: Paging — multiple customers reporting console login failures, looks correlated to Okta token introspect errors. seeing 5xx from auth provider in our logs. anyone oncall?
incidents-bot: @sre-oncall-1 on-call page triggered (SEV2) — incident created: INC-2026-0432.
sre-oncall-1: I'm on it, grabbing logs and rate graphs. assigning kevin-sre to help.
kevin-sre: thx. first glance: spikes in 503s from /oauth2/v1/introspect from okta-east-1, request_id examples: abc123, def456. infrequent 200s but token verification path failing for console sessions.
maria-ic: customers hitting interactive console login, SSO flows fail, tokens rejected. CS already seeing tickets. julie-cs can you confirm impacted tenants?
julie-cs: confirmed ~18 tenants in last 20m, mostly EU and NA. Notified high-touch customers. adding status page note draft: "Login issues for some customers; investigating".
sre-oncall-1: digging into auth-proxy logs: showing upstream_error: "503 Service Unavailable" and "upstream read timeout". sample: ```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Tue, 15 Mar 2026 15:12:07 GMT
X-Okta-Request-Id: abc123
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"server_error","error_description":"Introspect backend temporary failure"}
```
kevin-sre: can we fall back to JWT verification for unaffected endpoints? console uses introspect to check token active state. if we can validate locally by kid/JWKs + expiry, it might reduce dependency.
sam-platform: we have a fallback flag in auth-proxy: AUTHZ_FALLBACK_STRATEGY=jwt_verify; not enabled in prod by default. we can flip to reduce introspect calls but need to ensure we still block revoked tokens. tradeoff accepted as short-term mitigation.
sre-oncall-1: plan: 1) enable AUTHZ_FALLBACK_STRATEGY=jwt_verify for console route only, 2) temporarily increase introspect timeouts and add circuit-breaker to fail fast, 3) notify okta support and attach request ids. starting step 1 now.
kevin-sre: doing a canary: kubectl -n prod set env deploy/auth-proxy AUTHZ_FALLBACK_STRATEGY=jwt_verify --record && kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -l role=console-proxy
sre-oncall-2: watching metrics: console login success rate improves for canary pods. no regressions in other flows so far. :thumbsup:
maria-ic: create fallback alert to disable if error spikes. also add metric for token_revocation_rate so we can revert if revocations are being missed.
incidents-bot: Okta status page shows "degraded performance" for OAuth introspection in us/eu regions — https://status.okta.com/incidents/okta-2026-03-15-1
kevin-sre: filed support case with Okta (#CASE-998877). provided logs and request ids. okta-support-bot: Thanks, we've received your case. We're investigating. (case CASE-998877). ETA next update 15m.
julie-cs: posting status update to customers: "We're seeing an issue with Okta's token introspection causing some login failures. We've enabled a temporary fallback and are monitoring — more updates soon."
sre-oncall-1: added circuit-breaker rule to auth-proxy: failures_threshold=5, cooldown=30s, fallback=enabled. command: ```
# patch config map
kubectl -n prod patch configmap auth-proxy-cfg --type merge -p '{"data":{"introspect_failure_threshold":"5","introspect_cooldown_s":"30","fallback":"jwt_verify"}}'
```
kevin-sre: trace from a failed login: ```
[2026-03-15T15:09:12Z] user=acct-123 path=/console login attempt token_id=tok-456 status=introspect_503 okta_req=def456
```
sre-oncall-2: rolling canary to 20% of console pods. monitoring latency and 5xxs. so far success rate +30% for canary.
maria-ic: we should prepare an incident timeline and severity. Customer impact: interactive console logins fail intermittently; API token-based server-to-server flows mostly unaffected. propose SEV2.
kevin-sre: agreed SEV2. documenting timeline in incident doc. will add mitigation steps and telemetry links.
incidents-bot: @sre-oncall-1 handed off on-call to @sre-oncall-2 for next 2h per schedule.
sre-oncall-2: oncall ack, continuing runbook. next I will check whether our cached JWKs are fresh; if Okta rotated keys that could cause verification mismatches.
sam-platform: confirmed JWKs last fetched 2026-03-15T14:30Z, should be recent. looks like transient backend 503s not JWT rotation.
julie-cs: CS requests template message for impacted accounts with ETA. draft: "We're applying a temporary fallback to reduce login failures; you may need to retry for a short period. We'll update in 30 minutes."
kevin-sre: Okta updated case: they show "partial degradation in introspect for a subset of tenants due to upstream infra". recommended to retry with exponential backoff.
sre-oncall-1: next mitigation: enable retry/backoff and increase introspect timeout from 2s to 4s and add jitter. patch applied.
kevin-sre: runbooks updated, adding post-incident action item to evaluate long-term fallback policy and token_revocation_check via webhook.
maria-ic: preparing incident bridge notes for postmortem. julie, CS will follow up with customers who reported.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-0432 status update: mitigation in place (fallback enabled), monitoring.
sre-oncall-2: still seeing a trickle of failures in non-console authz paths — temporarily limited introspect calls to interactive sessions only. command: ```
# set route-specific flag
kubectl -n prod exec -it deploy/auth-proxy -- /bin/sh -c "set-route-flag console_only_introspect=false"
```
maria-ic: we should capture how many tokens might have been accepted without introspect (revoked tokens risk). add to postmortem risk assessment.
kevin-sre: agree — added metric token_revocations_missed=unknown, will query logs to estimate.
okta-support-bot: Case CASE-998877 update: Root cause identified in Okta edge cache layer, corrective deploy in progress. Next update 10m.
julie-cs: publishing customer update: "Okta reports a partial degradation; we've applied a safe fallback to reduce impact. We'll notify if anything changes."
sre-oncall-1: handing off to kevin-sre for follow-up and postmortem writing. kevin, you're lead.
kevin-sre: taking lead, will draft postmortem and remediation plan (longer-term: add signed revocation webhook or event stream to avoid introspect dependency).
maria-ic: thanks team. once stable let's verify rollback plan for fallback and ensure no missed revocations. closing loop after OKTA confirms fix. :white_check_mark:
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-0432 — resolved (monitoring) as of 2026-03-15T15:30:39Z.
